message.content: The agent inspected 164 log files in /app/logs, confirmed all 94,547 lines match the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS [SEVERITY]` format with dates matching filenames, wrote and ran /app/analyze_logs.py to generate /app/summary.csv with severity counts for today, last_7_days, last_30_days, month_to_date, and total (reference date 2025-08-12), and independently re-verified all counts matched exactly.
